children: UK specialty polymers maker's H1 2026 revenue grew 72% yr/yr, driven by detergent demand
Company achieved break-even adjusted EBITDA for the first time, with stable gross margins, while pre-tax and net loss narrowed
Net cash flow from operating activities improved as inventories normalized and demand increased
Itaconix expects FY 2026 revenue of at least $14.8 mln and a small positive EBITDA
Company maintains medium-term revenue ambition of $30 mln, driven by detergent market demand
PERFORMANCE INGREDIENTS GROWTH - Revenue rose 104% in Itaconix Performance Ingredients, driven by higher re-ordering volumes and two new large detergent customers in EMEA and North America
UNIT-DOSE DETERGENT DEMAND - Increased adoption of plant-based scale inhibitor and odour neutraliser ingredients in solid unit-dose dishwasher and laundry detergents boosted sales
SPARX FORMULATED SOLUTIONS - Incremental revenue growth from SPARX Formulated Solutions reflected increased use by North American brands and new product introductions
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the specialty chemicals peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Itaconix PLC is GBp375.00, about 81.2% above its September 7 closing price of GBp207.00
The stock recently traded at 298 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 184 three months ago
